Homepage.subtitle: Welcome to Azura World Hotel Alanya – All-Inclusive Concept
Homepage.title: 5-Star Comfort, All-Inclusive Experience
Homepage.text: Located in Turkler, Alanya/Antalya, Azura World Hotel is a 5-star, All-Inclusive resort opening in 2025. There are a total of 188 rooms, 6 floors, and 2 elevators. Check-in is at 14:00, check-out is at 12:00. The beach is 1 km away; shuttle service is available to the beach. Pets are not allowed.

TwoImageSection.subtitle: AZURA WORLD HOTEL UNFORGETTABLE MOMENTS
TwoImageSection.title: Discover the Azura World Hotel experience now!
TwoImageSection.text1: Azura World Hotel serves with an All-Inclusive concept in the Turkler region. It offers a pleasant holiday with comfortable room options, spa areas, and dining points throughout the day.
TwoImageSection.text2: Indoor Pool, Oasis Pool, and Aquapark with 13 different slides offer both relaxation and entertainment options together. The beach area is 125 meters; sunbeds, umbrellas, cabins, WC, and shower facilities are available at the beach.

Accomodation.subtitle: Choose the Most Suitable Accommodation for You
Accomodation.title: Comfortable Accommodation Options
Accomodation.roomText1: Deluxe rooms range from 22–24.99 m². They feature 1 French Bed or 2 Single Beds + 1 Sofa Bed. Maximum occupancy is 3 adults.
Accomodation.roomText2: Superior rooms range from 25–40 m². They feature 1 French Bed. Maximum occupancy is 2 adults.
Accomodation.roomText3: Deluxe Family rooms range from 43–53 m². They have 2 bedrooms (1 French Bed + 2 Twin Beds). Maximum occupancy is 4 adults + 1 child.

Essentials.subtitle: Discover Our Extraordinary Services
Essentials.title: Everything for Comfort
Essentials.text1: The 125-meter beach area features 120 sunbeds and 60 umbrellas; cabin, WC, and shower facilities are available. The beach is 1 km away; shuttle service is provided to the beach.
Essentials.text2: Indoor Pool (1 main + 1 kids pool), Oasis Pool (271 m²), and Aquapark area (1613 m²) with 13 slides are available. Aquapark hours: 10:00–12:00 / 15:00–17:00.
Essentials.text3: Breakfast/lunch/dinner buffets at Milos Restaurant; Saffron A’la Carte (with reservation); dessert service at Patisserie Art; snack service at Azura Beach.
Essentials.text4: Mini Club and children's playground are among the free services.
Essentials.text5: Fitness Center, Wi-Fi, beach towels, sunbeds, umbrellas, and beach shuttle service are among the free services.
Essentials.text6: Indoor Pool, steam room, Turkish bath, sauna, and salt room are free; massage services are extra charge. Operating hours: 08:00 – 19:00.

InfoSection.subtitle: Azura World Hotel Alanya
InfoSection.title: Your Ideal Holiday Address
InfoSection.text: Azura World Hotel is a 5-star All-Inclusive resort with 188 modern rooms, opening its doors in 2025. It is located in Turkler, the popular district of Alanya.

MissinonVision.subtitle: Azura World Hotel Values
MissinonVision.title: Our Mission and Vision
MissinonVision.text: Our mission is to offer our guests a holiday experience at high standards. Our vision is to be the preferred leading accommodation center in the Alanya region.
MissinonVision.clubtext1: We bring holiday pleasure to its peak with rich food and beverage options, huge pools, an aquapark with 13 slides, and a comprehensive spa center.
MissinonVision.clubtext2: In addition to free Wi-Fi, beach service, kids club, and rich activities; we also offer paid airport transfer, room service, and dry cleaning services.

ExploreAlanya.description1: Dim Cave, one of the best-known natural beauties of Alanya, offers a fascinating underground world with its huge stalactites and stalagmites formed over thousands of years.
ExploreAlanya.description2: Unique city and sea views can be watched along the line from Damlatas to Alanya Castle.
ExploreAlanya.description3: A natural paradise with cool waters, famous for its walking platforms and waterfalls.
ExploreAlanya.description4: Dating back to the 13th century, this shipyard is one of the best-preserved historical structures in the Mediterranean.
ExploreAlanya.description5: The museum where Mustafa Kemal Atatürk stayed during his visit to Alanya, and where his personal belongings are exhibited.
ExploreAlanya.description6: A world-famous 2.5-kilometer coastline with golden sands and crystal-clear sea.
ExploreAlanya.description7: The historical lighthouse at the harbor entrance is ideal for sunset walks.
ExploreAlanya.description8: A popular beach with clear waters, close to the city center.
ExploreAlanya.description9: A magnificent castle complex from the Seljuk period, located on the hill overlooking Alanya.
ExploreAlanya.description10: The historical structure that is the symbol of the harbor with its octagonal architecture.
ExploreAlanya.description11: A historical cave famous for its stalactites and stalagmites, known to be good for asthma.
ExploreAlanya.description12: A rich collection reflecting the history of Alanya and its surroundings from ancient times to the present.
ExploreAlanya.description13: A stop waiting to be discovered for history enthusiasts with its ancient ruins and colonnaded streets.
ExploreAlanya.description14: A beach known for its wide coastline, with bicycle and walking paths.
ExploreAlanya.description15: A castle mosque with a peaceful atmosphere reaching from the Seljuk period to the present.
ExploreAlanya.description16: A legendary cave which is a popular stop for boat tours.
ExploreAlanya.description17: A hidden cooling spot for those looking for peace in nature.
ExploreAlanya.description18: A cute stop on the coastline arranged for animal lovers.
ExploreAlanya.description19: A monumental structure in ancient Side, famous for its sunset view.
ExploreAlanya.description20: One of Antalya's most famous natural beauties, a relaxation and rafting area.
ExploreAlanya.description21: The most favorite cooling spot of Alanya with its restaurants by the water and picnic areas.
